Russia tests NATO's eastern defences
Issued on:
Share
Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone came down in Poland on Friday in what Prime Minister Donald Tusk said was likely an "intentional provocation" timed to coincide with European military exercises in the country for a possible postwar mission in Ukraine. Senior Lecturer in Conflict and Security at King's College in London, Domitilla Sagramoso, shares further insights.
